headline: Meta and Apple team up to make Muse AI models run better on Macs
summary: Meta unveiled its Muse Spark Open AI model, claiming it's the "most capable US open-weight model to date." It's the first in its class to run on desktops, specifically Apple M5 Ultra Mac Studios. This collaboration leverages Apple's MLX framework for optimized performance on Mac hardware.

headline: Sony made a $5,900 gold-plated Walkman MP3 player
summary: Sony launched a new line of Walkman portable media players with high price tags. The NW-ZX900 starts at an already steep $1,899.99. The premium gold-plated NW-WM1ZM3 model costs an extravagant $5,899.

headline: Volvo will use Nvidia’s tech for hands-free, point-to-point driving
summary: Volvo plans to introduce hands-free, point-to-point driving by 2030. The system will be powered by Nvidia's advanced AI technology. This Level 2++ automated driving system is akin to Tesla's Full Self-Driving (Supervised).

headline: Alienware’s latest 34-inch QD-OLED gaming monitor is $50 off
summary: Alienware's AW3426DW 34-inch QD-OLED gaming monitor is currently discounted. It's available for $742.22 on Amazon, a savings of over $50. This recently launched monitor features Penta Tandem quantum dots for vibrant display.

headline: Get a Perlegear Full Motion TV Wall Mount for Up to 90" TVs With 135lb Capacity for Just $33
summary: A Perlegear Full Motion TV Wall Mount is on sale for just $33. It supports TVs up to 90 inches with a 135lb capacity. The mount is UL 2442 compliant, tested to hold four times its max advertised weight.

headline: LEGO Venetian Neighborhood Set Is Coming in November
summary: LEGO announced a new Venetian Neighborhood set, slated for a November release. This detailed set will retail for $550. It promises to be a gorgeous addition for LEGO enthusiasts.

headline: The Batman Part II Production Pause Is Not Permanent, DC Studios Confirms
summary: DC Studios confirmed that the production pause for "The Batman: Part II" is not permanent. Co-CEO Peter Safran addressed concerns about the film's status. Fans can expect the sequel to resume production.

headline: A Massive Decompilation Community Is Shutting Down, Thanks to the Deluge of AI Decomps and Ports
summary: A large gaming decompilation community is closing down. The shutdown is due to a recent influx of AI-powered game decompilations and ports. AI tools are rapidly creating new versions, rendering manual efforts obsolete.

headline: Former DUP leader Donaldson sentenced to 15 years in prison for child sex abuse
summary: Former DUP leader Jeffrey Donaldson received a 15-year prison sentence. He was convicted of 18 counts of child sex abuse, including one of rape. The crimes were committed against two women when they were minors.

headline: Trump calls off livestream of Fort Hood attacker's execution by firing squad
summary: Donald Trump canceled the livestream of Nidal Hasan's execution by firing squad. Hasan, the Fort Hood attacker, was the subject of the first military execution in over 60 years. Trump stated that some preferred not to watch the killing.

headline: Trans people should use hospital spaces according to biological sex, NHS England says
summary: NHS England issued new guidance on hospital spaces for trans patients. The guidance states trans patients should be cared for on single-sex wards aligning with their biological sex. This aims to clarify policies for patient comfort and privacy.

headline: Russell Brand accuser says he turned 'monster-like' before alleged rape
summary: An accuser of Russell Brand described him becoming 'monster-like' before an alleged rape. Brand faces seven charges in total, including three counts of rape. He is also charged with three sexual assaults and one indecent assault.
